, the current design specifications are unconservative for the design of the CFS built-up beams that fail in distortional failure mode, hence, new design procedures and equations were proposed to improve the design strength predictions.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the direct strength method can be used to design CFS built up sections.

CFS built up sections are not as simple as the sum of individual CFS members, and the current design specifications for CFS structural members need to be modified to account for the interaction between CFS members in a built up section.
the design of the built up beams should be based on the distortional buckling mode and not on the local buckling mode.
